title: Vibrant Smoky Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A smoky and juicy Moroccan dish featuring lamb, cayenne pepper, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a monsoon evening
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Stir in the smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and sliced almonds, and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the lamb and apricots to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
Strain the sauce through a fine mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding the solids
Bring the sauce to a boil and cook until reduced and thickened, about 10 minutes
Serve the lamb and apricots with the reduced sauce spooned over the top
